title: object door: fieldGroups[].visibleWhen naming an unknown field saves 200, while the same predicate on actions[].visible or fields.*.visibleWhen is refused 422
body:
`reach:` an author who misspells a field in a field group's `visibleWhen` (Studio, the metadata API or an overlay) gets a 200. The renderer gates sections fail-closed, so the whole group, header included, disappears from every form and detail page. Nothing at authoring time says why. The same typo on a field's `visibleWhen` or an action's `visible` is refused at the same door.

## Reproduction (twice, on two fresh showcase boots at `fb91e979`, as the seed admin)

1. `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qa_fg_probe` with body:
   `{"name":"qa_fg_probe","label":"QA","sharingModel":"private","fields":{"name":{"type":"text","label":"Name"},"stage":{"type":"text","label":"Stage","group":"g1"}},"fieldGroups":[{"key":"g1","label":"G1","visibleWhen":"record.no_such_field == 'x'"}]}`
   answers **200** `state=active`, and `GET /meta/object/qa_fg_probe` reads the predicate back verbatim.
2. The same predicate as `actions:[{"name":"qa_go","label":"Go","type":"url","target":"https://example.com","visible":"record.no_such_field == 'x'"}]` answers **422** `INVALID_METADATA`, rule `expression-invalid`, at `action 'qa_go' visible`.
3. The same predicate as `fields.stage.visibleWhen` answers **422** `expression-invalid`.

- **Expected:** step 1 is refused 422 `expression-invalid`, as in steps 2 and 3.
- **Actual:** it saves.

## Mechanism

- The object door's author-time expression passes (`packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts`, the #22032 pass history) cover field-rule slots (pass 2), per-option `visibleWhen` (pass 3) and the object's own `actions[]` (pass 4). There is no pass over `fieldGroups[].visibleWhen`, and `validate-expressions.ts` has no `fieldGroups` site.
- The slot is live: `ObjectFieldGroupSchema.visibleWhen` (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`) is "shown only when TRUE, else hidden (fail-closed)". The form renderer enforces this (`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`, `isFailClosedSectionGate`).

## Done when

`fieldGroups[].visibleWhen` joins the object door's expression passes with the same rules as field `visibleWhen`, at the door and in `os validate` / build. A pin refuses the probe body above.
